title: Workbook Unit 1 — Section D
subtitle: who(m) / which / that · POINT 1·2 (WB p. 89)
introKo: 이 연습은 Section D 6문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기)으로 되어 있어요.

sections.title: Section D
sections.instructionKo: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. POINT 1·2. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)

items.label: D1
items.promptEn:
Do you know that boy? He is crossing the street.
→ Do you know that boy ________________?
accept: who is crossing the street
Do you know that boy who is crossing the street?
Do you know that boy who is crossing the street
that is crossing the street
Do you know that boy that is crossing the street?
Do you know that boy that is crossing the street
